data.long_meaning: Rohid is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rohini', which means 'brave' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Rohini is a star in the constellation of Taurus, and is also identified with the goddess of the same name, who is considered the mother of the moon.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rohid has roots in the rich Hindu tradition and is associated with the valor and strength of the star Rohini and the goddess of the same name. It adds a sense of heritage and pride for those who bear this name in the Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rohid is believed to represent the indomitable spirit and strength present within an individual. It serves as a constant reminder of the divine qualities of courage and resilience, and inspires one to face challenges and difficulties with bravery and determination. It also signifies a deep connection to the celestial bodies and the natural world in Hindu philosophical thought.

historical_references.reference: Rohid was a king in Magadha Province of ancient India around 5th century BC. He was a contemporary of Buddha and is mentioned in some Buddhist texts as a patron of Buddhism.
Rohid is also mentioned in Mahabharata, an epic Sanskrit text of ancient India, as a descendant of the Lunar Dynasty and a king of Haihayas.
